svg.title: The souls go down to Paradise, and the righteous rise with Christ
svg.desc: Detail of the redrawn Underworld chart. From the hill of the three crosses the soul of the penitent thief (Luke 23:43) and the soul of Christ go down to Paradise, and Christ's soul returns to His body. The righteous souls Christ took out of the underworld rise from Paradise past the crosses, marked with 2 Corinthians 5:8, Philippians 1:23, 2 Corinthians 12:2-4 and Revelation 2:7.

svg.text: Blue: the verses the study beside it rests each point on.
Dashed: Larkin’s caption the study does not follow (Ephesians 4:8-10).
Dotted: seen and heard across the gulf, never crossed (Luke 16:23-26). Whether
Luke 16:19-31 is a parable or an account of the far side of death is debated.
After the manner of Clarence Larkin · the-way.lewy.au
